generator: tools/research/proofing.mjs (English arm) and tools/research/proofing-ro.mjs (Romanian translate-then-proofread arm)
target_language: English proofread text (DS021 pipeline: SymbolicLM translation -> this proofreader -> SymbolicLM UD-to-SOP parse); the corpus target is text, never SOP
model_input: prompt (the message or, for pipeline=translate rows, its SymbolicLM English translation) only; kind, layer, signals, raw_oracle, target_oracle, checks, rights are evaluation/provenance-only fields, never model input
oracle: eval/reports/current/baseline-ud-rules/frozen-rules-v1.4 (Stanza + lib/ud-to-sop, SHA256SUMS-checked copy); a text passes when it is execution_equivalent to its source formalizer-v1 row's gold (eval/run.mjs)

input.translate_pipeline: SymbolicLM (lib/symbolic-lm/) English translation of a formalizer-v1 message; same underlying rights

rights.target: identity rows: identical to the input. repair rows: the model output named in each row's rights.target and target_source field, oracle-filtered and meaning-checked; DS014 'Model weights' (candidate LLMs) and 'LLM-authored text' (the Claude Haiku 4.5 teacher, oracle-filtered) carry the per-model licence
rights.rights_decision: owner-released-inspired-by (formalizer-v1's own decision, 2026-09-28) plus per-row model rights
rights.no_copy_check: not applicable: proofing copies no external source text (only formalizer-v1's own already-cleared messages and model-authored rewrites); tools/datasets/audit/proofing-overlap.mjs checks overlap with the sealed formalizer-v1/ood/wild suites instead

splits.hard_cases: datasets/proofing/hard_cases.jsonl (never a training target; DS021 boundary/role/relational-noun/assumed convention failures and rows nobody repairs)
splits.ro_translated: datasets/proofing/ro_translated.jsonl (Romanian arm: pipeline=translate rows, English input/target, source_language=ro; included inside train/dev by split_group_id, listed separately here because it is built by a different tool)

training_projection.note: training/cli.mjs dataset() requires {prompt, target} string fields per row under <data>/<role>/{train,dev}.jsonl. role() now accepts 'proofreader' (added 2026-09-30 alongside this training run: training/cli.mjs role(), training/python/train.py --role choices, and the qualification() dataset_files/contract_files schema were extended to a role-conditioned check list so a plain-text target role can be qualified without pretending its target is SOP); this corpus's training-ready rows are published under --data datasets/proofing --role proofreader (previously a workaround published them under the 'formalizer' role name). Only kind identity/repair rows (never hard, never a null target) are included, merging the direct-English arm and the Romanian translate arm. v2 (2026-09-30, proofing-data-agent): added 88 train / 3 dev / 98 hard_cases rows built from Haiku-diversified formalizer-v1 paraphrases (DS022 'LLM diversification', tools/research/build-proofing-v2.mjs), disjoint by split_group_id from datasets/proofing-diverse-dev/diverse-dev.jsonl (the held-out eval-proofreader-diverse-dev-v1 set) and from all eval/suites/**; row counts regenerated by tools/research/build-proofreader-projection.mjs.
training_projection.format: one row {id, prompt, target, kind, language, source_language, pipeline, target_source}; prompt is the raw text (no instruction wrapper), matching training/python/common.py chat_ids() (DS021 message-only input)

recommended_base_model.recipe: config/train-gemma.json (max_length 8192, existing recipe reused from formalizer-size-v1)
recommended_base_model.why: owner decision (coordinator message, corroborated by status/journal.jsonl 2026-09-29T21:37:26.749Z): CPU deployment speed at the target size beats Qwen3-0.6B; Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B remain untrained zero-shot reference points, not fine-tuning candidates

token_audit.format: matches training/python/common.py chat_ids(): user turn = row['prompt'] verbatim, assistant turn = row['target']; no system role, no added instruction (DS021 message-only input)

leakage_exclusions.note: formalizer-v1 template-collision identity rows whose text (input==target) coincided verbatim with a formalizer-v1/ood/wild sealed message; removed post-build, tools/datasets/audit/proofing-overlap.mjs now reports 0 exact matches

training_note: Dataset qualification only (status/training/qualification-proofing.json); this manifest asserts nothing about whether training is approved. A chatsop-training-authorization-v1 receipt, if issued, is a separate artifact from tools/research/qualify-dataset.mjs --authorize.
